issues.title: SignalR try to connect all current clients and CPU usage increase up to 100%
The ASP.net SignalR webapp is unresponsive when requests volume is high. We suspect deadlock in it.
signalr hub connection taking almost 40 seconds time to connect with server.
SignalR connections drain with Redis backplane
JS Client - Window unload event never unbind after stop connection

latest_release.body:
This is a patch release for SignalR 2.4.

This release brings minor bug fixes and improvements. It should be fully compatible with 2.4.0 applications.

See a list of issues fixed in this release here: https://github.com/SignalR/SignalR/issues?q=is%3Aissue+sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A2.4.3+

The following packages have been released to NuGet.org:

|Package ID|Version|
|-|-|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Client](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Client)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Core](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Core)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.JS](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.JS)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Redis](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Redis)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.StackExchangeRedis)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.SelfHost](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.SelfHost)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.ServiceBus](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.ServiceBus)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.ServiceBus3](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.ServiceBus3)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.SqlServer](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.SqlServer)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.SystemWeb](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.SystemWeb)|2.4.3|
|[Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Utils](https://nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AspNet.SignalR.Utils)|2.4.3|

Also, the localized satellite packages have been uploaded as well.

The following NPM modules have been released to npmjs.com

|Package ID|Version|Tag|
|-|-|-|
|[signalr](https://www.npmjs.com/package/signalr)|2.4.3|latest|

To install the preview release of the NPM package, use the command `npm install signalr`
